resolutions.researcher_notes: DEAD_LINK: the current_ref (archive.org/details/screenshot-2024-09-24-at-5.04.05-pm, a screenshot of Fusui County's 2024-06-11 annual work-plan page) passes url_verifier only on generic tokens present in the archive.org item's own metadata/description ('扶绥', the item title '扶绥-崇左天然气支线管道'), but fails on any token drawn from the actual page body ('工作计划'), i.e. the item record does not verifiably surface page content that supports the Status value 'construction' -- confirming the prior deep-sweep researcher's own finding ('200 but data value not found'; verdict 'unclear' in rows/P4725.json). Fresh Chinese-language search this pass (扶绥/崇左 天然气支线管道 开工/通气/投产/建成; 广投管网 崇左 扶绥 支线 建成/在建; 南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程 崇左段 施工/开工仪式) surfaced no dispositive hit for THIS specific branch (P4725/DN355.6mm/0.85 bcm-y/Guangxi Guangtou). Two adjacent, non-dispositive leads: (1) a verified 2025-06-03/06-06 Xinhua/Sohu/QQ story ('打通最后一站！广西实现天然气市市通', http://www.gx.xinhuanet.com/20250606/032105f0711e4633a1f26693d3eba852/c.html) reporting Chongzuo's FIRST connection to the national trunk network via a DIFFERENT PipeChina-owned line (Nanning-Pingxiang branch, Nanning-Chongzuo section -- 114.76km/DN457mm/0.7 bcm-y, matching roster PID P4732, not P4725) on 2025-06-03 -- speaks to the national backbone connection, not to whether this separate, provincially-owned Guangtou branch (fed from the Nanning-Fusui line, not the national trunk) was already built/operating; (2) a chinapipe.net paid-tender listing for a related but DISTINCT downstream tie-in project, '崇左（崇左分输站-中燃合建站）天然气管道工程' (a short connector FROM the Chongzuo Distribution Station -- P4725's own EndLocation -- to a China Gas city-gas joint station), published 2024-09-24, whose visible field gives 建设周期 (construction period) '2024年至2025年' -- a different project, so it neither confirms nor cleanly contradicts P4725's own status, but shows construction activity ongoing at that same station as late as 2024-2025. No source found that verifiably supports 'construction' as P4725's current status; leaving UNRESOLVED per standing rules 2/3. Recommend a follow-up search directly against 崇左市发改委/广西广投天然气管网 announcements for '扶绥崇左天然气支线管道' + '通气'/'投产'.

2019-02-25 Guangxi DRC project-approval document (桂发改能源〔2019〕169号, reprinted by gas.in-en.com, recovered via Wayback after the live URL 403'd to automated fetches) is explicitly for a natural-gas ('天然气') branch pipeline throughout; confirms Fuel=Gas. Independently corroborated by the row's own existing current_ref (an archive.org screenshot of www.fusui.gov.cn's 2024 work plan, whose archive.org item title is literally '扶绥-崇左天然气支线管道' -- a second, independent government body naming the identical gas project).

No source found that verifiably supports ConstructionYear=2023. The one document found (2019-02-25 Guangxi DRC approval, gas.in-en.com/Wayback) sets an approval date of 2019 and requires construction to start within 2 years (extendable by at most 1 more), i.e. by roughly early 2022 absent a renewal -- in mild tension with a 2023 construction-start value, as the prior deep-sweep researcher also flagged. Fresh Chinese search this pass ('扶绥-崇左天然气支线管道 开工建设 2023年', '南宁-扶绥天然气支线管道工程 崇左 开工仪式') found no announcement of a 2023 groundbreaking/construction-start for THIS specific branch. The only adjacent construction-timing lead is for a distinct downstream tie-in, '崇左（崇左分输站-中燃合建站）天然气管道工程' (chinapipe.net, published 2024-09-24), whose visible field states 建设周期 '2024年至2025年' -- a different, shorter connector project (Chongzuo Distribution Station to a China Gas joint station), not the 83km Fusui-Chongzuo branch itself, so it is not proposed as a ref for P4725's ConstructionYear and is not strong enough to overturn 2023 either. Leaving UNRESOLVED rather than propose a ref for an unconfirmed year or fabricate a URL.
Approval doc states design throughput '8.48亿m3/年' = 0.848 bcm/y, rounding to GEM's recorded 0.85 bcm/y. Verified live: url_verifier confirms token '8.48' present on the Wayback snapshot.

Verified: tokens '扶绥', '崇左', and '渠座村' all present.
Approval doc: total investment '约28974.11万元' = 289,741,100 RMB, within ~0.003% of GEM's recorded 289,750,000 RMB -- effectively the same figure. Verified: token '28974' present.
